extension_design_version: Model 9 p038 endpoint confirmation extension v1
purpose: Test whether the widest fresh-front contrast, pareto_038 versus pareto_032, represents a reproducible AEP-versus-rotor-transit trade-off.

analysis_provenance.candidate_selection_stage: pareto_038 was selected after the five-batch fresh validation of the full NSGA-II run and before any seed-30142 p038 result existed.
analysis_provenance.interpretation: This is a transparent independent confirmation extension, not the original pre-specified p037 primary test.

source_full_run.selection_reason: lowest mean fresh E_RT_CE among the 51 training-Pareto layouts

extension_test.method: two-sided paired Student-t interval across the 15 matched batches
extension_test.tradeoff_gate: pass only when the interval upper bound is below zero and pareto_038 AEP is lower than pareto_032 AEP

interpretation_boundary: Rotor transit is an exposure endpoint, not blade collision, fatality, or mortality.
